tool_args.rationale: At horizons near 3.45, observations are approximately proportional to current input and the fast transient is damped. Fit a local linear forecast with initial-state and horizon corrections, then test it on fresh confirmation; the underlying global dynamics are not identified.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; the resulting eight observations support a low-parameter fit at the target horizon.
The authorized formula omits the observed dependence on initial state and is not established as this task's mechanism.
The inputs remain correlated and the horizons narrow, so their additional parameters are not well identified; a local coarse forecast is more economical.
The nuisance measurement is irrelevant to identifying the forecast law.
